```{r}
# Convert timestamps and extract time features
df$timestamp <- ymd_hms(df$timestamp, tz = "UTC")

df$hour <- hour(df$timestamp)
df$weekday <- wday(df$timestamp, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)
df$week <- isoweek(df$timestamp)

df$month <- as.factor(df$month)
```

## Bayesian Modelling with INLA

```{r}
# Create time index
df$time_idx <- seq_len(nrow(df))
```

```{r}
# INLA (Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation) model with RW1 and covariates
formula_baseline <- air_temp ~ f(time_idx, model = "rw1") + hour + month

result_baseline <- inla(formula_baseline,
                        data = df,
                        family = "gaussian",
                        control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
                        control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE))

summary(result_baseline)
```

```{r}
# INLA (Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation) model with AR1 and covariates
formula_ar <- air_temp ~ 1 + f(time_idx, model = "ar1")

result_ar <- inla(formula_ar,
                  data = df,
                  family = "gaussian",
                  control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
                  control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE))

summary(result_ar)
```

```{r}
# INLA (Integrated Nested Laplace Approximation) model with RW1
formula_rw <- air_temp ~ 1 + f(time_idx, model = "rw1")

result_rw <- inla(formula_rw,
                  data = df,
                  family = "gaussian",
                  control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
                  control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE))

summary(result_rw)
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
# Keep only relevant columns

summary(hydroranger_df)
head(hydroranger_df)
```

```{r}
# Visualise water level distribution
hist(hydroranger_df$water_level_avg)
```

```{r}
# Identify missing timestamps
hydroranger_df$timestamp <- as.POSIXct(hydroranger_df$timestamp, tz = "UTC")

full_seq <- data.frame(
  timestamp = seq(
    from = min(hydroranger_df$timestamp),
    to = max(hydroranger_df$timestamp),
    by = "15 min"
  )
)
attr(full_seq$timestamp, "tzone") <- "UTC"

missing <- anti_join(full_seq, hydroranger_df, by = "timestamp")

ggplot(missing, aes(x = timestamp)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  labs(title = "Missing timestamps per hour")
```

```{r}
# Create complete dataset with missing flag
df_full <- full_seq %>%
  left_join(hydroranger_df, by = "timestamp") %>%
  mutate(missing = ifelse(is.na(water_level_avg), 1, 0))

df_full <- df_full %>%
  mutate(hour = hour(timestamp),
         date = as.Date(timestamp))
```

```{r}
# Visualise missing data against air temperature
ggplot(df_full, aes(x = timestamp)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = air_temp), colour = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(data = df_full %>% filter(missing == 1),
             aes(y = 0), colour = "red", size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = "Missing timestamps (red) vs Air temperature over time",
       y = "Air temperature (°C)", x = "Time") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Analyse weather conditions before data gaps to identify patterns
df_full <- df_full %>%
  arrange(timestamp) %>%
  mutate(missing_shift = lag(missing, default = 0),
         gap_start = (missing == 1 & missing_shift == 0))

gap_context <- df_full %>%
  filter(gap_start) %>%
  left_join(
    df_full %>%
      mutate(timestamp_next = lead(timestamp)) %>%
      select(timestamp_next, air_temp_prev = air_temp,
             air_humidity_prev = air_humidity),
    by = c("timestamp" = "timestamp_next")
  )

ggplot(gap_context, aes(x = air_temp_prev)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Air temperature before data gaps",
       x = "Air temperature (°C)", y = "Count")
```


```{r}
# Function to plot histogram of variable before data gaps to identify patterns
plot_gap_hist <- function(df_full, var, bins = 20) {
  var <- ensym(var)

  df_full <- df_full %>%
    arrange(timestamp) %>%
    mutate(missing_shift = lag(missing, default = 0),
           gap_start = (missing == 1 & missing_shift == 0))

  gap_context <- df_full %>%
    filter(gap_start) %>%
    left_join(
      df_full %>%
        mutate(timestamp_next = lead(timestamp)) %>%
        select(timestamp_next, prev_value = !!var),
      by = c("timestamp" = "timestamp_next")
    )

  ggplot(gap_context, aes(x = prev_value)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = bins, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution of", as_string(var), "before data gaps"),
      x = paste(as_string(var), "before gap"),
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r}
plot_gap_hist(df_full, "water_level_avg")
```

```{r}
# Identify outliers in water level data
find_outliers <- function(x) {
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR_val <- Q3 - Q1
  lower <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_val
  upper <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_val
  outliers <- which(x < lower | x > upper)
  return (outliers)
}

outlier_idx <- find_outliers(df_full$water_level_avg)
df_full[outlier_idx, c("timestamp", "water_level_avg")]
```

```{r}
# Plot water level time series with outliers

     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Water Level")
```

```{r}
# Highlight negative water level values
low_vals <- df_full %>%
  filter(water_level_avg < 0) %>%
  select(timestamp, water_level_avg)

ggplot(df_full, aes(x = timestamp, y = water_level_avg)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = low_vals, aes(x = timestamp, y = water_level_avg),
             color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Water level with high values highlighted")
```

```{r}
# Fix negative water level values by interpolation
df_fixed <- df_full %>%
  arrange(timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    water_level_avg = ifelse(water_level_avg < 0, NA, water_level_avg),
    water_level_avg = na.approx(water_level_avg, x = timestamp, na.rm = FALSE)
  )
```

```{r}
# Plot interpolated water level time series
plot(df_fixed$timestamp, df_fixed$water_level_avg, type = "l",
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Water Level")
```

```{r}
# Fix anormaly high water level values by interpolation
```

```{r}
#NEXT STEPS COULD BE TO FILL IN MISSING DATA USING PREVIOUS VALUES

# Select only numeric columns
numeric_df <- df_fixed %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))

# Compute correlation matrix (use pairwise to handle missing data)
cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

ggcorrplot(cor_matrix,
           method = "square",
           type = "lower",
           lab = TRUE,
           lab_size = 2.5,
           title = "Feature Correlation Heatmap",
           colors = c("steelblue", "white", "darkred"))
```

```{r}
# Interactive correlation heatmap
heatmaply_cor(
  cor_matrix,
  xlab = "Features",
  ylab = "Features",
  main = "Interactive Correlation Heatmap",
  colors = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "darkred"))(256)
)
```

## Modelling
### GAMs

```{r}
# Prepare time data for GAM modelling
hydroranger_modelling <- df_fixed %>%
  mutate(
    month = as.numeric(format(timestamp, "%m")),
    week  = as.numeric(format(timestamp, "%U")) + 1,
    hour  = as.numeric(format(timestamp, "%H")) +
      as.numeric(format(timestamp, "%M")) / 60,
    weekday = wday(timestamp, label = TRUE, week_start = 1),
    hour_of_week = (as.numeric(weekday) - 1) * 24 + hour
  )
```

```{r}
# Baseline GAM model for water level prediction
knots_baseline <- list(hour = c(0.5, 24.5), week = c(0.5, 52.5),
                       month = c(0.5, 12.5))

water_level_model_baseline <- bam(formula = water_level_avg ~
                                    s(air_temp, k = 200, bs = "cr") +
                                      s(air_humidity, k = 200, bs = "cr") +
                                      s(hour, k = 10, bs = "cc") +
                                      s(week, k = 20, bs = "cc") +
                                      s(month, k = 12, bs = "cc"),
                                  family = gaussian(),
                                  data = hydroranger_modelling,
                                  knots = knots_baseline,
                                  discrete = TRUE,
                                  select = TRUE)

summary(water_level_model_baseline)
plot(water_level_model_baseline, scheme = 2, pages = 1)
```

```{r}
gam.check(water_level_model_baseline)
```

```{r}
# Enhanced GAM model with interaction term
knots_model <- list(hour = c(0.5, 24.5), week = c(0.5, 52.5),
                    month = c(0.5, 12.5), hour_of_week = c(0.5, 168.5))

water_level_model <- bam(formula = water_level_avg ~
                           s(air_temp, k = 200, bs = "cr") +
                             s(air_humidity, k = 200, bs = "cr") +
                             s(hour, k = 10, bs = "cc") +
                             s(hour_of_week, k = 200, bs = "cc") +
                             s(week, k = 20, bs = "cc") +
                             s(month, k = 12, bs = "cc") +
                             ti(hour, air_temp, bs = c("cc", "cr")),
                         family = gaussian(),
                         data = hydroranger_modelling,
                         knots = knots_model,
                         discrete = TRUE,
                         select = TRUE)
```


```{r}
gam.check(water_level_model)
```

```{r}
summary(water_level_model)
```

```{r}
plot(water_level_model, scheme = 2, pages = 1)
```
